description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for filtering search parameters related to Buzz comments in the OrangeHRM plugin. It extends a base FilterParams class and specifies sorting options and a share ID filter.

classes.name: BuzzCommentSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for passing search filter parameters for Buzz comments, including sorting and share ID.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object and sets the default sort field to 'comment.createdAtUtc'.

methods.name: getShareId
methods.description: Retrieves the share ID used to filter comments.

methods.name: setShareId
methods.description: Sets the share ID to filter comments by.
